Since the original timing only measures the SpMV loop and not initialization, keeping the full matrix generation on rank 0 is acceptable even though it means rank 0 temporarily holds the whole matrix in memory.\n\nFor partitioning, I'll balance by nnz rather than row count, since that's cheap to compute from the rowDelimiters using lower_bound to find row boundaries where the cumulative nnz crosses each rank's target share -- this gives good load balance with minimal extra work, and the local delimiters just need their offsets rebased after scattering.\n\nSince the x vector is constant across iterations and has random column access patterns, each rank needs a full copy broadcast once before timing starts, avoiding per-iteration communication. The output just gets recomputed locally each iteration and gathered via Gatherv only at the end for validation; for timing, I'll use a barrier before the loop and reduce the max time across ranks afterward to capture the slowest rank's wall time.\n\nFor the local SpMV kernel, I'll keep each rank's row delimiters rebased to local indices rather than trying to offset into the global value array, since the kernel indexes values by absolute position from the delimiters — rebasing is simplest and keeps per-rank memory to nnz/P. For timing, I'll use MPI_Wtime with an MPI_Reduce MAX across ranks to report a single elapsed time in milliseconds, matching the original output format.\n\nFor row partitioning, I compute boundaries by target nonzero counts per rank using 64-bit arithmetic and lower_bound against the row delimiter array, clamping properly so ranks can end up with zero rows when numRows is smaller than the process count, while still keeping boundaries monotonic and valid.\n\nNow I'm working out the scatter logic: each rank's nonzero range comes from its row boundaries, and I distribute values and column indices with MPI_Scatterv using appropriate MPI types, then separately send each rank's local slice of row delimiters since those overlap between ranks and can't use a simple scatter.\n\nI'll just do blocking point-to-point sends from root for the rebased delimiters since it's one-time setup overhead, though I'm also considering having every rank generate the full matrix locally to skip communication, but that trades off against memory at scale.\n\nSo root precomputes rebased delimiter values for each rank before scattering, keeping each rank's values within its own local range, then uses Scatterv with per-rank counts to distribute them simply.\n\nFor the vector, I think it's easier to just broadcast the full vector to all ranks rather than scatter pieces, so root initializes the vector, values, columns, and delimiters all together before distribution.\n\nI need to handle the edge case of zero items on root gracefully, since empty data pointers in MPI calls with zero count should be safe. I also want to verify the reference solution on root with full data before timing begins, and make sure each iteration's output gets properly gathered after local computation. All diagnostic printing should be gated to rank 0 only, and argument parsing needs to happen consistently across ranks after MPI_Init, with clean finalization on error paths rather than abrupt returns.\n\nFor the actual matrix work, only rank 0 needs to seed and generate the full matrix since other ranks don't require randomness, and verification/reference computation should also stay root-side since only root holds the complete arrays. The local sparse matrix-vector kernel stays unchanged since rebasing the row pointers to start at zero lets me reuse the existing CPU spmv function directly on local data, while root still runs the full reference computation on the complete arrays.\n\nI'm now checking edge cases: zero rows or zero nnz leave the partition logic assigning everything to rank zero with empty ranges elsewhere, which should still gather correctly, but I notice sparsity of zero would cause a division-by-zero when computing nItems.\n\nFor MPI, I need to standardize on MPI_UINT32_T for index_t transfers rather than trying to make it a compile-time constant, since Open MPI's predefined datatypes aren't true constexpr values. I'm also confirming that Scatterv/Bcast calls for row and nonzero offsets are safe since sendbuf is only significant at the root rank, so non-root ranks passing empty or null buffers is fine.\n\nWriting MPI scatter logic...\n\nFor validation, root computes the reference result and compares it to the gathered output, broadcasting a pass/fail flag so every rank exits with the same status code before finalizing MPI.\n\nI'll make sure the result printing happens before the validation step, use an isRoot flag so only rank 0 prints, and keep argument parsing errors consistent across ranks—root prints the usage message, all ranks exit with code 1. Now I'll write out the complete file.\n\n","time":{"start":1793074334884,"end":1793074362095},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

Summation order per row is preserved, so results are bitwise identical to the serial code. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793074379507,"sessionID":"ses_e84719343ffe9BuicxklPwS5qG","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01NjnD338vs82MK5MWxyS2SU","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/spmv/spmv.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: partitionRows\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Splits the matrix rows into contiguous blocks, one per MPI rank, with the\n//   number of nonzeros in each block approximately balanced.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rowDelimiters: CSR row delimiters (size dim+1), valid on root only\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   nItems:        total number of nonzero elements\n//   nprocs:        number of MPI ranks\n//\n// Returns:\n//   vector of size nprocs+1; rank r owns rows [result[r], result[r+1])\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nstd::vector<index_t> partitionRows(const index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t dim,\n                                   const index_t nItems, const int nprocs) {\n    std::vector<index_t> rowStart(nprocs + 1, 0);\n    rowStart[nprocs] = dim;\n    for (int r = 1; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n        const index_t target = static_cast<index_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(r) * nItems / nprocs);\n        const index_t* it = std::lower_bound(rowDelimiters, rowDelimiters + dim + 1, target);\n        index_t row = static_cast<index_t>(it - rowDelimiters);\n        row = std::min(row, dim);\n        rowStart[r] = std::max(row, rowStart[r - 1]);\n    }\n    return rowStart;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n    const bool isRoot = (rank == 0);\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    bool exitEarly = false;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            exitCode = 0;\n            exitEarly = true;\n            break;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            exitCode = 1;\n            exitEarly = true;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if (exitEarly) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return exitCode;\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    // Row-delimiter and nonzero offsets are exchanged as 32-bit values and\n    // per-rank counts are passed to MPI_Scatterv as int.\n    if (static_cast<uint64_t>(nItems) > static_cast<uint64_t>(INT_MAX) ||\n entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n        printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Dense vector is replicated on every rank (used by all local rows)\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);\n\n    // Full matrix data exists only on root, which generates it with the same\n    // sequence of rand() calls as the serial code.\n    std::vector<double> h_val;\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols;\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters;\n    if (isRoot) {\n        h_val.resize(nItems);\n        h_cols.resize(nItems);\n        h_rowDelimiters.resize(numRows + 1);\n\n        printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n        fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n        fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n        initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(h_vec.data(), static_cast<int>(numRows), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, rowStart(nprocs + 1, 0);   // rank r owns rows [rowStart[r], rowStart[r+1])\n    std::vector<index_t> nzStart(nprocs + 1, 0);    // rank r owns nonzeros [nzStart[r], nzStart[r+1])\n    if (isRoot) {\n        rowStart = partitionRows(h_rowDelimiters.data(), numRows, nItems, nprocs);\n        for (int r = 0; r <= nprocs; ++r) {\n            nzStart[r] = h_rowDelimiters[rowStart[r]];\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(rowStart.data(), nprocs + 1, MPI_UINT32_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Bcast(nzStart.data(), nprocs + 1, MPI_UINT32_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts(nprocs), rowDispls(nprocs), nzCounts(nprocs), nzDispls(nprocs);\n    for (int r = 0; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n        rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStart[r]);\n        rowCounts[r] = localRows = static_cast<index_t>(rowCounts[rank]);\n    const index_t localNnz = static_cast<index_t>(nzCounts[rank]);\n\n    // Scatter the local nonzero values and column indices\n    std::vector<double> localVal(localNnz);\n    std::vector<index_t> localCols(localNnz);\n    MPI_Scatterv(h_val.data(), nzCounts.data(), nzDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                 localVal.data(), static_cast<int>(localNnz), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Scatterv(h_cols.data(), nzCounts.data(), nzDispls.data(), MPI_UINT32_T,\n                 localCols.data(), static_cast<int>(localNnz), MPI_UINT32_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Scatter row delimiters rebased so each rank's local nonzero indices start at 0\n    std::vector<index_t> rebasedDelims;\n    if (isRoot) {\n        rebasedDelims.resize(numRows);\n        for (int r = 0; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n            for (index_t i = rowStart[r]; i < rowStart[r + 1]; ++i) {\n                rebasedDelims[i] = h_rowDelimiters[i] - nzStart[r];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    std::vector<index_t> localRowDelimiters(localRows + 1);\n    MPI_Scatterv(rebasedDelims.data(), rowCounts.data(), rowDispls.data(), MPI_UINT32_T,\n                 localRowDelimiters.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), MPI_UINT32_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    localRowDelimiters[localRows] = localNnz;\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution on root\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate && isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation on local rows\n    std::vector<double> localOut(localRows);\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double tStart = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(localVal.data(), localCols.data(), localRowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, localOut.data());\n    }\n\n    const double tLocal = MPI_Wtime() - tStart;\n    double tMax = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&tLocal, &tMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // durationMs = static_cast<long long>(tMax * 1000.0);\n\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        const double avgTime = durationMs / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n\n        printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(h_out,
